literal: Destruction even if it yields, without failing, to the king benefit that which yields is an envoy.
translation: A true envoy is one who secures benefit for his king without faltering, even if it brings destruction upon himself.
modern: தனக்கு அழிவே வந்தாலும், சிறிதும் தயங்காமல் தன் அரசனுக்கு நன்மையைத் தேடித்தருபவரே சிறந்த தூதுவர் ஆவார்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate loyalty and courage required of an envoy. The word 'இறுதி' (destruction or death) highlights the extreme danger an envoy might face in a hostile court. 'எஞ்சாது' means without shrinking back or failing in duty. Even when facing personal ruin, a true envoy ('தூது') ensures that his actions and words yield ('பயப்பது') only benefit ('உறுதி') to his king ('இறைவற்கு').
